audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Skill/Kennen/Kennen against a packet of Skill, Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Skill, Gnar, Gnar — and every corresponding whys[] entry already says Gnar owns those levels.
audit.why: Levels 2-3 are Hyper on-hit poke against a fragile Kennen; first item and beyond is a Mega frontline. Level 1, 4-5 and 6 are genuinely coinflips (rage state decides). The mirror flipped exactly these four rows on Gnar's side.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 5, 6 flipped to Gnar as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; the level-6 comparison was written with no numbers.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30s and only exists while the rage bar is full; Wallop is a flat 7s in Mega form; Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s over a 550 radius. That asymmetry — a 7s recurring stun against your 120s ultimate — is the actual spike story.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries GNAR!'s 90s rank-1, Wallop's 7s and the flat 120s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors repeated across six fields. (1) Slicing Maelstrom is called a channel that Gnar's stun 'interrupts'. (2) GNAR! is labelled '(W)'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Slicing Maelstrom is 'Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions' — the kit file carries only a zone flag, no channel flag. Kennen moves and fights while it ticks; being stunned does not end it, it only strands him. GNAR! is Mega Gnar's R (590 range, wall-slam stun); Mega Gnar's W is Wallop, the 7s smash-down stun.
audit.corrected: whys[5], spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, mid, late, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1] rewritten: Wallop and GNAR! stun you inside or out of the 550 storm radius rather than interrupting a non-existent channel, and the slot letters are corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing about GNAR! creating a wall-slam and cutting retreat.
audit.why: GNAR! carries terrain and knockup flags — 'Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned' — and Kennen's only mobility is Lightning Rush at 170 range on a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Named in spikes[2].text and late; Flash is for the wall, not the damage.

edits.before: This is where you claw it back. At 6 your Slicing Maelstrom turns a marked Gnar into a stun-lock kill: E-in to apply a mark, channel R to restack Mark of the Storm fast, and burst him before he can boomerang away — but ONLY when his rage bar is empty and he's stuck in mini form. The whole mid game hinges on the rage bar: if it's full, his GNAR! (W) AoE stun will interrupt your R channel and flip the all-in, so wait it out and force the fight on his small, squishy form.
edits.after: This is where you claw it back. The whole mid game hinges on the rage bar: if it's full, Wallop's 7s stun and the GNAR! wall-slam pin you while the storm burns down, so wait it out and fight his small, squishy form.

edits.before: You need to have closed it. Once Gnar hits two items he's a Mega-form frontline who survives your R window and CCs your team while staying out of E range in mini form. Your squishy caster body can be focus-killed the moment R is down, and his GNAR! stun is a free interrupt on every engage you try. Pivot to teamfight engager — flank and R the backline rather than dueling a transformed Gnar in the sidelane, because he reclaims the straight 1v1 here.
edits.after: You need to have closed it. Once Gnar hits two items he's a Mega-form frontline who survives your R window and CCs your team while staying out of E range in mini form. edits.before: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. E-dash it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — 90s at rank 1, his Mega wall-slam all-in. Fight while the rage bar is empty. - Wallop (flat 7s): Mega's stun. - Your R: flat 120s, kill windows only.

notes: The 'R channel' framing was in six places on this page and is not a real mechanic — Slicing Maelstrom cannot be interrupted, so a Gnar stun strands Kennen rather than cancelling the storm. GNAR! was also labelled (W) in three places; Mega Gnar's W is Wallop. focus.text and the loading line still track 'Gnar GNAR!' when the recurring 7s Wallop is the more relevant cooldown, but those strings are short and were left alone.
